notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
easyPrerequisites: Energy Arc exiled by Elite Arcanist.
description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Elite Arcanist by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Energy Arc and casting the copy without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Energy Arc, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.
